Hi Alex —

Thanks again for walking through BrightLayer's use case today. Quick recap from our side and the asks we agreed on during the call: 

- Primary workloads: customer chat (real-time assistant), embeddings for semantic search, and a small reranking pipeline for top-N results.
- Wants from BrightLayer: per-model monthly volumes (tokens or calls), target unit economics (target $ / 1M tokens) or monthly spend range, and any hard requirements (SLA, data residency, compliance).

Action items for you:
1) Confirm estimated steady-state token volumes per model: chat, embeddings (please indicate whether you report embeddings as vectors or input tokens), and rerank.
2) Share your target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range so we can model Dedicated vs Hosted economics.
3) Attach any volume spreadsheets you already have (we discussed a short template).

From Redwood: we will:
- Put together a costed model-mix proposal showing per-model pricing and expected monthly run rates (we'll show both hosted per-token rates and a Dedicated reserved-capacity estimate).
- Highlight quick wins (KV prefix caching for chat, batching for rerank) that can lower unit cost.

Would you be able to send numbers and the spreadsheet by tomorrow EOD PT? If not, what is a good time for a 30-minute follow-up?

Thanks,

Cc: \nDate: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model mix & token volumes — next steps

Hi Marissa —

Great demo — thanks. Below are the rough monthly numbers we use for planning today (happy to refine):

- Chat (real-time assistant)
  - Model: chat-large-v2 (mostly user prompts + small system messages)
  - Estimated tokens/mo: 800,000,000 (800M)
  - Typical request size: 250 tokens in + 150 tokens out average

- Embeddings (semantic search indexing + similarity)
  - Model: embed-small-v1
  - We measure embeddings in calls; current plan: 10M embedding calls/mo. Approx input tokens for embeddings ~ 2 tokens/tokenized char average -> approx 200,000,000 tokens equivalent (200M)

- Rerank (batch reranking of candidate lists)
  - Model: reranker-v1
  - Estimated tokens/mo: 50,000,000 (50M)

Total: ~1,050,000,000 tokens / mo (1.05B)

Budget: we are targeting a unit economics target of around $750 / 1M tokens as a blended target. There is some room to go up to ~$1,000 / 1M for early pilot if the quality and latency are solid; long term we'd like to get to $600–800 / 1M for scale.

Other notes:
- Compliance: we need SOC2 evidence and a simple data retention statement for pilot.
- We're open to a 3-month pilot on Hosted to validate before discussing Dedicated committed capacity.

I've attached our quick spreadsheet with the numbers.

Cheers,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Partnerships, BrightLayer, Inc.
alex@brightlayer.com

Alex —

This is perfect, thanks for the detail — exactly what we needed. Quick reactions and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Model mix & pricing approach
- We'll model three scoped SKUs: chat (chat-large-v2), embeddings (embed-small-v1), and rerank (reranker-v1).
- Using your numbers (800M chat / 200M embeddings / 50M rerank = 1.05B tokens), I'll build a blended hosted rate and a Dedicated committed estimate.

2) Unit economics assumptions
- For the proposal I'll show a target blended rate at your $750 / 1M tokens and a sensitivity table at $600, $750, $1,000 / 1M to show monthly spend and monthly savings if you move to Dedicated at different commit levels.

3) Compliance & procurement
- Rishi will drop SOC2 artifacts and a short data-retention blurb into the doc.
- If pilot works, we'll follow your procurement cadence and can prepare a short SOW + DocuSign-ready contract.

Next call: Are you available Wed 21 Jul between 10:00–12:00 PT for a 30m to walk the numbers together? If so we can do a shared spreadsheet and iterate live.

I'll attach the initial model-mix PDF and the combined workbook after I run the numbers.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
